name: smith kneeling hip thrust
description: A kneeling hip thrust on the Smith machine that trains hip extension and the glutes.
instructions: Set the bar on the Smith machine at a low height and kneel facing away from it.
Place the bar across your hips with a pad for comfort.
Keep your torso upright and your core braced.
Thrust your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
